title: A-800 assembly & design review
registerRevision: 2026-09-10 · Physical equipment ownership and complete Explore assemblies
lead: KBH₄ doping pyrolysis of rGO: contained rGO elevator TR-801, rGO and dry-KBH₄ hoppers H-801 / H-802 with reagent charge lock LK-802, weighing feeders F-801 / F-802, inerted ploughshare mixer MX-801, surge hopper H-803, rotary valve RV-801, doping pyrolysis and cooling furnace PY-801 with PSV-801, off-gas cooler E-801, pressure-control fan FN-801, dry-argon regulation AR-801, O₂ / moisture / H₂ verification AIT-801, feeder access structure PL-801 and the utilities / A-900 battery limit BL-800-UTIL.

findings.topic: KBH₄ : rGO ratio and feed-rate basis
findings.reason: The reagent ratio and the rGO rate set reagent flow, hydrogen evolution, potassium vapour, furnace duty and every feeder rating in the area.
findings.observation: D-A800-01 applies the DBM V2.0 / MOC-001 ruling of 1 : 1 KBH₄ : rGO (PFD V5.1.1, REP-019 and REP-022 agree); DAT-008 item 2.6 and the MEB-010 R_KBH4 of 1.5 are superseded, not deleted. The rGO rate is withdrawn: 15.75 kg/h (MEB-010, on 50 kg/h graphite), 25.2 / 37.8 kg/h (DAT-008), 28.07 kg/h (REP-019 / 022) against the DBM V2.0 17 / 22 kg/h rGO (411 / 535 kg/d). With them go the KBH₄ feed rate (37.8 kg/h on the old ratio), hydrogen evolved, the F-801 / F-802 / PY-801 powers and the MEB-010 21.8 kW duty, which omits the ≈ 44 kW reaction heat.
findings.action: Revise FEED-PE-DAT-008 (V1.1), FEED-PE-MEB-010 (V9) and Narrative §4.13 / capacity tables to 1 : 1 at the DBM V2.0 rate; restate H₂ evolution, K vapour, off-gas and reagent flows and the feeder ratings.

findings.topic: PY-801 design closure and REP-022 thermal correction
findings.status: Design basis approved — five RED items open
findings.reason: A driven endothermic reactor is sized on reaction heat and residence, not on the heater allowance of a screening balance.
findings.observation: D-A800-02 adopts the REP-019 closure as the design-basis statement: one continuous indirectly electrically heated screw-furnace train, 1.10 m ID × 10 m retort, 1.05 m screw at ≈ 0.285 rpm, five zones, 120 kW installed, 2 h at 750 °C under argon; H-803 as a 3.75 m³ mass-flow wedge hopper with a 120 kg reactive-inventory cap; RV-801 not accepted as both metering device and airlock. REP-022 supersedes the thermal basis: ≈ 44 kW endothermic reaction heat at 1 : 1 (five times the 8 kW allowance), so the 120 kW installed duty must be re-checked. Five RED items: ratio (closed), 5 °C/min ramp vs 2 h residence (≈ 4.5 h needed), pressure "a few mbar" vs the +2 psig / −3 mbarg statements, the 585–700 °C molten-salt window, and ≈ 20 kg/h potassium vapour.
findings.action: Close the four remaining REP-022 RED items and re-check the installed duty against the reaction heat before freezing the PY-801 package; reconcile the pressure sign and value in the P&ID basis.

findings.topic: Inert atmosphere, hydrolysis hazard and hazardous area
findings.status: Approved from DAT-008 — HAC to confirm
findings.reason: KBH₄ hydrolyses with moisture and the furnace evolves hydrogen; the inert envelope and the area classification follow.
findings.observation: Approved (D-A800-02, DAT-008): ≤ 200 ppm O₂ in the mixer envelope, ≤ 100 ppm H₂O in feed streams and inert gas (KBH₄ hydrolysis hazard), argon ≥ 99.999 % (≤ 2 ppm O₂ at source), Zone 1 / 2 gas plus Zone 21 / 22 dust internal. The model provides the dry-argon regulation manifold AR-801 (2,229 parts), the O₂ / moisture / H₂ verification assembly AIT-801 and the reagent charge lock LK-802 — none on LST-001.
findings.action: Confirm the hazardous-area classification on the HAC drawing; define the argon demand of AR-801 with the A-6000 inert-gas ruling (D-A6000-01) and the moisture-control basis of the KBH₄ supply chain (LK-802, H-802).

findings.topic: Off-gas basis: hydrogen and potassium vapour — S3 segregation
findings.status: Segregation required — S3 header, K condenser
findings.reason: A hydrogen-rich argon stream carrying potassium vapour must be treated as a continuous process stream with a hot-end condenser, never combined with wet or CO-bearing vents.
findings.observation: D-A800-02 adopts REP-041: H₂ 12–35 Nm³/h (30–55 vol % in Ar) with 10–20 kg/h potassium vapour — treat H₂ as a continuous process stream and the K / B aerosol as fouling and materials exposure; segregate as system S3 with a hot-end K condenser; PSV-801 and the vent branch to ASME B31.12 (MAT-002 M-054). PSV-801 shares model equipment 109 with PY-801; the relief and residue interfaces have no destinations.
findings.action: Confirm S3 segregation and the K condenser on FEED-PFD-3000 and the A-800 P&ID; give PSV-801 its own register identity and set-pressure basis; assign the relief and residue destinations.

findings.reason: Dry KBH₄ and rGO powders demand grounded, electropolished contact surfaces; the furnace and off-gas train see potassium and alkali condensate at temperature.
findings.observation: D-A800-MOC applies MAT-002: 316L electropolished, grounded and bonded with hard-faced wear locations for H-801 / F-801 / MX-801 / H-803; 316L dry-contact with PTFE / PFA / PVDF for the KBH₄ side H-802 / F-802; Alloy 602 CA or 601 for PY-801; Alloy 601 or Ni 200 / 201 in the hot / alkali-condensing sections of E-801 and FN-801; PSV-801 316 / 316L welded to ASME B31.12. MDL-001 (304L, high-purity alumina retort) superseded. RV-801 has an MDL-001 material only.
findings.action: Extend MAT-002 to RV-801; issue the A-800 datasheets on the MAT-002 base case once the ratio / rate revision (A800-01) is in.

findings.reason: Every equipment item in the area must have one identity in the register, the model and the data layer.
findings.observation: Nine LST-001 tags (H-801, H-802, F-801, F-802, MX-801, H-803, RV-801, PY-801, E-801, FN-801) are bound to model geometry. The model additionally owns TR-801, LK-802, AR-801, AIT-801, PL-801, BL-800-UTIL, two fire points and two emergency stations without register identities. Design notes name C-801 / C-802 screw feeders where the register, PFD-0800 and the model have the loss-in-weight feeders F-801 / F-802, and an E-802 that is on neither. DAT-008 is unsigned with 14 blank items.
findings.action: Register TR-801, LK-802, AR-801, AIT-801, PL-801 and BL-800-UTIL on LST-001; retire the C-801 / C-802 names or map them to F-801 / F-802; rule E-802 in or out; complete and sign DAT-008 on the revised basis.

findings.topic: Access, reactive inventory and fire points
findings.reason: Dry-reagent handling on an elevated feed structure needs rated access, a capped reactive inventory and fire points at the approaches.
findings.observation: The model provides the feeder access and equipment-support structure PL-801 (1,080 parts), fire points at the dry-reagent stair approach (FE-801) and the doping service frontage (FE-802), and two emergency stations. REP-019 caps the H-803 reactive inventory at 120 kg; the KBH₄ charging route through LK-802 and the reagent interface IF-A800-REAGENT are records without a defined supply chain.
findings.action: Qualify PL-801 against the reagent charging, feeder and mixer maintenance tasks; define the KBH₄ supply, container handling and charge-lock procedure; confirm fire-point and station positions in the plant-wide access and fire-safety reviews.

findings.topic: Equipment datasheets — hoppers H-801 / H-802 / H-803 and coolers E-801 / E-802
findings.status: Preliminary datasheets issued — candidate values, none approved
findings.reason: The three hoppers had no volume and E-801 / E-802 no duty; REP-019 had sized them on the 28.07 kg/h rGO rate that D-A800-01 withdrew, so its criteria — not its numbers — carry over.
findings.observation: FEED-PE-CAL-020 V1.0 re-applies the REP-019 criteria on the DBM V2.0 design rate (535 kg/d = 22.3 kg/h rGO, KBH₄ 1 : 1, product 35.7 kg/h; 0.794 × the REP-019 basis) under the bases approved in review (N1 rate, N2 REP-019 criteria, N3 E-802 300 °C design inlet). FEED-PE-DAT-044: H-801 3 h at 20 kg/m³ = 3.34 m³ working, 4.2 m³ gross. FEED-PE-DAT-045: H-802 0.25 m³ gross with the 80 kg reactive-inventory cap. FEED-PE-DAT-046: H-803 3.75 m³ gross / 3.0 m³ working, 120 kg cap (the D-A800-02 capacity basis). FEED-PE-DAT-047: E-801 screening 23.6 kW (argon 8.63 kW unchanged, H₂, other and K condensation scaled) → 35 kW normal / 65 kW installed by the REP-019 margin ratios, 750 → 80 °C, Alloy 601 / 602 CA hot section and Ni 200 / 201 condensation surfaces. FEED-PE-DAT-048: E-802 2 kW design (1.82 kW at 300 → 70 °C; 0.44 kW at the MEB-010 125 °C inlet), jacketed screw on cooling water, 316L EP proposed — E-802 remains a placeholder tag. They enter as 69 candidate rows — none approved; every A-800 missing-value gap now has a source; throughputs are quoted, not re-harvested, and hopper / E-801 materials do not contest the MAT-002 ruling.
findings.action: Close the holds — bulk-density, flow-function and wall-friction tests (P1), the open REP-022 PY-801 items that set the E-801 inlet and potassium load (P2, A800-02), the E-802 identity (P3, A800-06), routing and the electrical basis (P4) and S3 segregation with the K condenser (P5, A800-04) — add E-802 to MAT-002, then approve the sizing values by decision.

findings.topic: PY-801 furnace train datasheets — PY-801, FN-801, F-801 / F-802, RV-801A/B
findings.status: Preliminary datasheets issued — pressure and ramp / residence ruled (D-A800-03)
findings.reason: The equipment sweep of 2026-09-24 found the furnace train without datasheets: CAL-020 held PY-801 on the REP-022 open items (hold P2) and the fan, feeders and lock followed it; PY-801 is the A-800 cost and hazard driver.
findings.observation: FEED-PE-CAL-027 and FEED-PE-DAT-072…076 (register V5.0) on bases Q1–Q8 approved by QFL 2026-09-24. PY-801 keeps the REP-019 closure (1.10 m × 10 m retort, 0.285 rpm, 2 h, 750 °C, 120 kW installed) on the CAL-020 N1 rate (22.29 kg/h rGO, 1 : 1 — 0.794 × REP-019): 89 kg inventory, 25 % fill; the REP-022 reaction heat on N1 (34.9 kW) replaces the 8 kW allowance, so the load is 73.3 kW calculated, 91.6 kW design, and the 120 kW is re-zoned 18 / 18 / 48 / 18 / 18 because Z3 alone needs 44 kW. H₂ 18.5 Nm³/h normal, 37 upset; K + B 20.6 kg/h. FN-801: hydrogen-rated booster E-801 / K condenser → S2 oxidiser, 150 m³/h (100 m³/h design at 40 °C), 50 mbar screening, 1.1 kW, 1 + 1. F-801 / F-802: loss-in-weight, 22.3 kg/h design, 10–40 kg/h. RV-801A/B: double inert lock, not a meter. PSV-801: CAL screening only (≈ 9 cm² at 200 mbar(g), DN80 class) — relief cases from the HAZOP. D-A800-03 rules the operating pressure at +1 to +3 mbar(g) (set point +2; mechanical envelope +250 / −50) in place of the MEB-010 −3 mbar(g) approval, and defines the approved 2 h (solids time in Z1–Z5) and 5 °C/min (maximum solids heating rate through 550–700 °C, ≥ 2.5 m of heated length). 91 rows harvested late; only the pressure approved.
findings.action: Measure the blend reaction enthalpy by TGA-DSC (REP-041 M2) before the heater package is frozen; qualify the hot-zone material; run the HAZOP relief cases and issue PSV-801; design the potassium condenser and the S2 oxidiser (AB-3801) and replace the fan screening pressure; raise the PFD-0800 / Narrative MoC (+2 psig → +2 mbar(g), 1 : 1, ramp definition).
